note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 165 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera. Original in English; only the soldier is known, the alate is recorded as unknown, and workers and nymphs are lacking; synonymic lists, bibliographic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted; the maximum width of the postmentum (given in the original OCR as “0.32..0.33”) is not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly incurved at the middle, frons slightly concave and wrinkled; antennae 13-segmented, 3rd segment shortest, 4th equal to the 2nd; labrum subrectangular, anterior margin convex with an indistinct point; mandibles short and stout, strongly hooked; postmentum rod-like, waist posterior and strongly incurved; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin notched, posterior margin slightly concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, slightly darker anteriorly; antennae and labrum pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown; pronotum and legs paler than the head capsule; abdomen dirty white. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, with short setae. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly incurved at the middle; frons slightly concave and wrinkled (to mandible base 1.57–1.63 mm, maximum width 0.89–0.91 mm). Antennae 13-segmented; 3rd segment shortest, 4th equal to the 2nd. Labrum subrectangular, anterior margin convex, with an indistinct point. Mandibles short, stout, strongly hooked (left mandible length 0.89–0.94 mm); coarsely serrate. Postmentum rod-like, waist posterior and strongly incurved (length 0.97–1.05 mm, waist width 0.17–0.19 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin notched, posterior margin slightly concave (length 0.31–0.33 mm, width 0.59–0.61 mm).
